'''Pablo Echenique Robba'''<ref>[http://podemos.info/candidatos/pablo-echenique-robba/ Pablo in Podemos page] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150222032907/http://podemos.info/candidatos/pablo-echenique-robba/ |date=2015-02-22 }}</ref> (born 28 August 1978) is an Argentine-born Spanish physicist and politician. As a scientist, he holds a position at the [[Spanish National Research Council]] in [[Zaragoza]] (CSIC).<ref name="elmundo01">{{Cite web |url=http://www.elmundo.es/cronica/2014/06/01/53898565268e3e54468b456b.html |title=El otro Pablo de Podemos |first=Martín |last=Mucha |date=1 June 2014 |publisher=Crónica de [[El Mundo (España)|El Mundo]] |accessdate=26 June 2014}} {{in lang|es}}</ref>

He came to Spain aged 13 to live in [[Zaragoza]]. He had [[Spinal muscular atrophy]].<ref name="materia">[http://esmateria.com/2014/05/30/yo-inclino-por-usar-ratoncitos-en-investigacion-para-acercar-una-medicina-humanos/  "En la izquierda a veces la gente se vuelve anticientífica"] Published by Materia on 30 May 2014 Consulted 26 June 2014 {{in lang|es}}</ref> Echenique was elected a member of the [[Congress of Deputies]] in the [[April 2019 Spanish general election]] along with the left-wing political party [[Podemos (Spanish political party)|Podemos]].<ref>{{cite web|title= Echenique Robba, Pablo |url= http://www.congreso.es/portal/page/portal/Congreso/Congreso/Diputados/BusqForm?_piref73_1333155_73_1333154_1333154.next_page=/wc/fichaDiputado?idDiputado=76&idLegislatura=13 |work= [[Congress of Deputies]] |accessdate= 11 June 2019 }} {{in lang|es}}</ref> Previously, Echenique was one of the five [[Member of the European Parliament|MEP]]s elected by [[Podemos (Spanish political party)|Podemos]] in the [[2014 European Parliament election in Spain|2014 European Parliament election]], and was a member of the [[Aragonese Corts]] between 2015 and 2017.<ref>{{cite news|first= Eduardo |last= López Alonso |title= Podemos, el partido revelación de Pablo Iglesias |url= http://www.elperiodico.com/es/noticias/europa/podemos-partido-revelacion-pablo-iglesias-3282574 |work= [[El Periódico de Catalunya]] |date= 26 May 2014 |accessdate= 3 July 2014 }} {{in lang|es}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|first= Luis |last= Giménez San Miguel |title= Los otros diputados de Podemos |url= http://www.publico.es/523420/los-otros-diputados-de-podemos |work= [[Público (España)|Público]] |date= 28 May 2014 |accessdate= 3 July 2014 }} {{in lang|es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title= Echenique Robba, Pablo |url= http://www.cortesaragon.es/Ficha-Personal.1399.0.html?tx_parlament_pi5%5BshowUid%5D=1963 |work= [[Aragonese Corts]] |accessdate= 29 October 2016 }} {{in lang|es}}</ref>

In October 2020, he was fined €11,040 for the irregular employment of his assistant.<ref>{{cite news |title=Ratifican la multa de 11.000 euros a Echenique por no haber cotizado por su asistente |url=https://www.lavozdegalicia.es/noticia/espana/2020/10/21/ratifican-multa-11000-euros-echenique-haber-cotizado-asistente/0003_202010G21P18991.htm |access-date=11 February 2021 |work=[[La Voz de Galicia]] |date=21 October 2020 |language=Spanish}}</ref> In November 2020, he was fined €80,000 for saying that a man who was murdered in 1985 was a rapist.<ref>{{cite news |title=Echenique y Del Olmo, condenados a pagar 80.000 euros por una falsa acusación de violación |url=https://www.lasexta.com/noticias/nacional/echenique-condenado-pagar-80000-euros-llamar-violador-inocente_202011175fb3fef5cdfdea00018b024c.html |access-date=11 February 2021 |publisher=[[La Sexta]] |date=17 November 2020 |language=Spanish}}</ref> [[The Supreme Court]] subsequently annulled this conviction after concluding that he did not make a direct accusation against the plaintiff's brother, but rather expressed a show of solidarity with his political colleague.<ref>{{cite web|date=17 October 2022|first=Alberto|last=Pozas|title=El Supremo anula la condena de Echenique a pagar 80.000 euros por acusar a un hombre de violación|url=https://www.eldiario.es/politica/supremo-anula-condena-echenique-pagar-80-000-euros-acusar-hombre-violacion_1_9577391.html|website=eldiario.es}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>
